title: Independent computational test of anomeric selectivity in Ni-catalyzed glycosyl C–Ge coupling
difficulty_reasons: Two competing transition-state families must be discovered and validated from precursor models; conformer coverage and TS characterization are nontrivial.

paper.title: Stereoselective C(sp3)-Si/Ge bond formation via nickel-catalyzed decarboxylative couplings

data.description: Complete SI-identified precursor geometries: 49-atom NHPI ester, 45-atom Ni(0)L, neutral-doublet 60-atom int1 and 31-atom glycosyl radical R; source/identity manifest and Angstrom coordinates. No TS/product geometry or numerical answer.

required_deliverables.description: Validated independent pathway search, barriers, comparison, evidence, uncertainty and conclusion conforming to submission_schema.json.
